desc_sharing_collab:
Adding a collaborator is meant to share specific permissions with other users. This allows multiple people to view and edit the application and see responses.

There are three types of collaborators:
  • Responses: Can view application responses.
  • Editing: Can edit and publish the application.
  • Editing + Responses: Can publish the application and view responses.
